evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and directly modifies contrib/guix build scripts, toolchains, patches, and verification checks.
rationale: Enables release binaries to run across non-glibc distributions like Alpine, older Linux distributions, and NixOS by producing static-pie executables. Reviewers and users across multiple distros verified this eliminates compatibility loaders and dynamic glibc version mismatches, while laying groundwork for security mitigations like pointer authentication.
